title: SF2327 (2021-2022 Regular): Permitted and trained school staff carrying of firearms authorization

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2021-03-25; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/92/2021/0/SF/2327/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Read the introduced bill (2021-03-25); no vote data in file.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 299C.26, subd. (b)): The training program must admit only school and postsecondary institution teachers and employees who have completed training for a permit to carry under section 624.714 within one year of the date of attending the training under this section or have a permit to carry under section 624.714.
Section 2 (Minn. Stat. 609.66, subd. 1d): (10) teachers and employees of public elementary, middle, and secondary schools; charter schools under chapter 124E; and postsecondary institutions under chapter 136F or 137 who have a school permit to carry under section 624.714, subdivision 8b.
Section 3 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, new subd. 8b): A teacher or other employee of a public elementary, middle, or secondary school; charter school under chapter 124E; or postsecondary institution under chapter 136F or 137 may apply to the sheriff of the county where the teacher or employee resides for a school permit to carry.
Section 3 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, new subd. 8b): A school permit to carry issued under this subdivision expires one year after the date of issue.
Section 4 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 18): (d) This subdivision does not apply to teachers and employees authorized to carry firearms under section 609.66, subdivision 1d, paragraph (f).
